question: What is the meaning of reused parts percentage out of the total product mass in relation to reused content?
data_point: reused parts percentage out of the total product mass
description: The percentage of reused parts out of the total product mass refers to the proportion of the product that consists of parts that have been previously used. This is a measure of the extent to which recycled materials are incorporated into the product. It is expressed as a range, indicating the minimum and maximum possible values, and is specified as a percentage of the total product mass. This measure helps to quantify the level of reuse in the product's manufacturing process.
